assertions.notes: Public booking on acme (Origin http://acme.menuza.test:3008, smsOptIn false, valid email) -> POST /reservations 201; confirmation captured within the same request (deliverAfterCommit, no tick needed). Capture checks: to = guest email, meta.messageKind = 'confirmation', subject 'Your reservation at Downtown Flagship is confirmed' (non-empty), html contains the location name (Downtown Flagship), the booking date/time ('Sunday, October 25, 2026', '6:00 PM'), 'Party size: 2', the manage link and an add-to-calendar link (https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?...&dates=20261025T220000Z/20261025T231500Z). Branding: email-theme hex colors present (#0a0a0a, #171717, #737373, #e5e5e5, #fafafa, #ffffff) and the theme font/radius applied inline. Custom note: PUT /operator/reservations/setup/message-texts (kind confirmation, locale en) -> the note appeared in the very next booking's confirmation (FANZ65QG, captured 12:41:17) and in no other kind (cancellation_guest, cancellation_restaurant, reminder captures contain no note text); the note was then removed and rsv_message_texts has no confirmation|en row. SMS: 0 [SMS MOCK] lines for +15555550622 (guest did not opt in).
assertions.limitations: Contract Tool is agent-browser; this group is a curl surface, so the flow was done through POST /reservations and the captured emails instead of Sites /reserve (no browser session opened). No screenshot of the rendered email; the captured HTML was verified structurally. Manage-link origin: the email contains http://localhost:3001/reserve/manage#t=... (the App origin), not http://acme.menuza.test:3008 - the known defect already recorded in the round's runtime findings; path+fragment form is correct and the token is only in the fragment. Logo: acme's Organization row has siteIconKey = null and siteTheme = null (local D1), so the email renders the layout's text fallback (org name) instead of a logo ; there is no logo configured for this org to render, so the 'logo' element of the branding parenthetical is not observable in this environment.

assertions.notes: Quiet hours were set on the acme location b5hymj7733l3wxrg74dytzty (America/New_York) to a window of 08:50-10:00 local (temporary) with reminderHours 33 so the raw reminder target of two 2026-10-18 dinner bookings (start-33h = 2026-10-17 13:00Z and 13:45Z = 09:00/09:45 EDT, both inside the window) is shifted earlier to the window start: rsv_messages send_at = 2026-10-17 12:50:00Z (08:50 EDT) for both rows (55 min and 10 min earlier than the raw targets). The rows stayed pending and were delivered at the adjusted time: tick HTTP 200 delivered 2 messages and the captures are reminder emails at 2026-10-17T12:50:21Z (kind reminder, status sent - not dropped, not cancelled). A confirmation booked while the clock was inside quiet hours (booking request 12:50:33.153Z = 08:50:33 EDT, HTTP 201) was captured immediately at 12:50:33.277Z with no tick in between (kind confirmation is never delayed by quiet hours). Settings were restored afterwards: b5hymj messaging version 4, resolved reminderHours 24 and quietHours 21:00-08:00 (baseline was {} which resolves to exactly these defaults).
assertions.limitations: The assertion was exercised at a secondary acme location (b5hymj...) instead of the flagship, because the flagship's message settings were being actively changed by other validators during this run (observed reminderHours 4 and reconfirm toggles at versions 44->54); this kept the change isolated to rows this group owns. The message-texts API merges patches and cannot delete stored keys, so the restore writes the default values explicitly (21:00-08:00, 24 h) - the resolved configuration equals the baseline {} but the stored JSON differs ({"kinds":{},"reminderHours":24,"quietHours":{"startMin":1260,"endMin":480}}). A manual tick was used for delivery; the 120 s interval tick was also live during the window.

frictions.description: Quiet-hours delivery needs the adjusted send time to be in the future when the message is reconciled; the first window choice left the raw target just outside the window (send_at kept the raw time).
frictions.resolution: Adjusted the temporary window (a second settings patch) so the raw targets fell inside it and the adjusted time was ~7 minutes ahead, then ticked and observed delivery.

frictions.description: The flagship's message settings changed twice during this run from other validators (reminderHours 24 -> 4, reconfirm toggles, versions 44 -> 54), which made any quiet-hours change at the flagship unsafe for other groups.
frictions.resolution: Kept all settings work on the b5hymj location and only patched the flagship's confirmation|en custom note (a texts-only patch that triggers no reconcile), removing it again right after the check.
